card.name: Linking words before a named drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly "with" after "treatment" and sometimes "or" between drug names, right before the name of a drug or drug class. Seen in infection, PML and antiviral warnings.

modes.label: "treatment with" before a drug
modes.description: The word "with" after "treatment" in a conditional sentence, just before a drug or drug class is named.
modes.example: If chickenpox develops, treatment<< with>> antiviral agents may be considered.

modes.label: "or" joining drug names
modes.description: The word "or" between two drugs in a list, just before the second drug.
modes.example: MAYZENT can generally be started immediately after discontinuation of beta interferon<< or>> glatiramer acetate.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a specific drug is named, as in "treatment with ...".
